rows.reasoning: She cosponsored H.R. 38, the Constitutional Concealed Carry Reciprocity Act, which loosens carry rules across state lines, and voted Yea on H.J.Res. 44 nullifying the ATF stabilizing-brace rule, a recorded vote against a new restriction. Per the annex, a reciprocity record plus a vote against a new restriction seats "Add no new restrictions, and at most loosen rules on carrying, such as honoring permits across state lines"; no record repeals a major federal law, so the rung-5 repeal clause is unevidenced.
